# Classik Finishes

> Classik Finishes is a Nigerian finishing company: paint application, wall screeding, Tyrolean and textured walls, POP, gypsum and suspended ceilings, tiling, epoxy and stamped floors, plus its own line of paints and coatings. Based in Nigeria and working across 8 states for homeowners, estate developers and commercial clients.

- Phone: 0704 502 2891 / 0912 399 3079
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/2347045022891
- Email: Classikfinishesltd@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/classik_finishes/
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@classik_finishes

## Services (rates include materials and labour, confirmed after a site measure)

### Overhead

- POP ceilings: from ₦12,000 per sqm. Coving, trays and recesses cast to your drawing or ours, finished smooth.
- Gypsum board ceilings: from ₦14,500 per sqm. Board work on true lines, joints taped and feathered before any paint.
- Suspended ceilings: priced on request. Grid systems for offices and commercial floors.

### Walls

- Paint application: from ₦700 per sqm. Interior or exterior, properly primed and finished with two coats.
- Wall screeding: from ₦1,900 per sqm. Smooth, even surfaces that give your walls a clean final finish.
- Tyrolean application: from ₦1,400 per sqm. A hard-wearing exterior texture designed for lasting performance.
- Textured designs: from ₦13,000 per sqm. Decorative wall textures tailored to your preferred design.

### Floors

- Tiling: from ₦2,500 per sqm. Floor and wall tiles laid neatly and perfectly.
- Epoxy flooring: priced on request. Smooth, seamless and durable floor coating with a clean finish.
- Stamped floor painting: priced on request. Decorative floor painting that adds colour, character and a finished look.

## Products (Classik Finishes paints and coatings)

- Screeding Finish (20L): Packaged ₦26,000, On-site production ₦22,000. Strong, fast-drying screed for interior and exterior walls, with wider coverage.
- Emulsion Finish (20L): ₦23,000. For walls and ceilings, interior and exterior.
- Matt Finish (20L): ₦65,000. For walls and ceilings, interior and exterior.
- Silk Finish (20L): ₦72,000. Rich coverage, smooth application, elegant sheen.
- Gloss Finish (4L): ₦22,600. Durable surface protection for wood and metal.
- Undercoat (4L): ₦19,000. A smooth base for a better finish.
- Graphitex (20L): ₦58,700. Lifetime anti-crack and anti-peel formula.
- Marble Stone (20L): price on request. Bold decorative texture finish.

## FAQ

**Do your rates include materials?**
Yes. Materials and labour are included. Rates start from the figures on our Offerings page and are confirmed after a site measure.

**How do I get a firm price?**
Send us your enquiry and we'll arrange a site visit to measure the space and confirm the price.

**Which items are priced on request?**
Suspended ceilings, epoxy flooring, stamped floor painting and Marble Stone depend on the site and design, so we quote them after a visit.

**Where do you work?**
We've delivered projects across eight states in Nigeria, for homeowners, estate developers and commercial clients.

**Can I buy your paints without hiring you?**
Yes. Add products to your enquiry from the Products page and we'll confirm availability and delivery.
